label: September 28 – October 4, 2026
intro: Build it, bake it, skate it — a jam-packed week of hands-on adventures for Bangkok's most curious 5-year-old.
weekday_note: Tuesday planetarium English show is a great midweek option — 10am sharp at the Science Center.

activities.title: Kids Cooking Workshop at A Little Something
activities.why: Thailand's original bilingual kids cooking school — Thor gets real kitchen skills. Chocolate and dessert sessions are fan favourites.
activities.tip: Check their Facebook for the current week's menu — sometimes it's themed (desserts, pizza, Thai food). Book 1–2 weeks ahead.

activities.title: Ceramic Workshop for Kids at ClassBento
activities.why: Pinch pots, slab building, coils — all the pottery techniques Thor can explore. Minimum age 5, so he's perfectly ready.
activities.tip: Book through classbento.co.th for the easiest slot selection. They confirm by email.

activities.title: Roller Dome at Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Emporium Shopping Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (BTS Phrom Phong)
activities.why: Rollerblading is Thor's jam — SE Asia's biggest rink with trained coaches available for young beginners.
activities.tip: Emporium is easy to combine with lunch at the food court. Weekends are lively but staff keep it safe.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.location: Bang Phli, Samut Prakan (30 min from central Bangkok)
activities.why: Iron Man suits, 3D/4D projections, 20+ Marvel heroes — this is Thor's dream day out. Literally his namesake is here.
activities.tip: Pre-book Klook tickets. Grab car from Sukhumvit costs ~200–300 THB. Avoid going after 4pm on weekends as it gets crowded.

activities.title: Science Center for Education & Bangkok Planetarium
activities.location: Science Center for Education, Sukhumvit (near BTS Ekkamai)
activities.price: Museum: ~50 THB adult / 30 THB child; Planetarium add-on: +30-50 THB
activities.why: 360-degree planetarium dome, interactive science exhibits, and a pirate ship for play — a full morning of exploration for curious Thor.
activities.tip: Tuesday English show only. Get there by 9:45am. Combine with the 4 museum buildings after — easily a 3-hour visit.
